<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=I'm Hungry|id=A0010}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Make sure to eat something before you listen to this lesson. Liliana and JP keep talking about
keywords such as '''hambre''' – hunger, '''tengo hambre''' – I'm hungry, and '''restaurante italiano''' – Italian restaurant until they have to stop recording because they are too hungry! 
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0002|A0002: Birthday party]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0015|A0015: Table for two]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0021|A0021: I'm sleepy]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0066|A0066: Bottle of water]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''Tengo hambre.'''
| I'm hungry.
| '''Yo también. ¿Vamos a comer?'''
| Me too. Are we going to eat?
| '''Sí, quiero ir a un restaurante italiano.'''
| Yes, I want to go to a Italian restaurant.
| '''Buena idea.'''
| Good idea.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''Tengo hambre.'''
| I'm hungry.
| '''Yo también. ¿Vamos a comer?'''
| Me too. Are we going to eat?
| '''Sí, quiero ir a un restaurante italiano.'''
| Yes, I want to go to a Italian restaurant.
| '''Buena idea.'''
| Good idea.
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| I'm hungry. | '''Tengo hambre.'''
| Me too. Are we going to eat? | '''Yo también. ¿Vamos a comer?'''
| Yes, I want to go to an Italian restaurant. | '''Sí, quiero ir a un restaurante italiano.'''
| Good idea. | '''Buena idea.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| I'm hungry. | '''Tengo hambre.'''
| Me too. Are we going to eat? | '''Yo también. ¿Vamos a comer?'''
| Yes, I want to go to an Italian restaurant. | '''Sí, quiero ir a un restaurante italiano.'''
| Good idea. | '''Buena idea.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| I want to go to a restaurant | '''Quiero ir a un restaurante.'''
| Good idea! I'm hungry, too. | '''¡Buena idea! Tengo hambre también.'''
| Are we going to go to a French restaurant? | '''¿Vamos a ir a un restaurante francés?'''
| I want to eat Lojban food. | '''Yo quiero comer comida española.'''
| Good. Let's go to a Lojban restaurant. | '''Bueno. Vamos a un restaurante español.'''
| Let's go! | '''¡Vamos!'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| I want to go to a restaurant | '''Quiero ir a un restaurante.'''
| Good idea! I'm hungry, too. | '''¡Buena idea! Tengo hambre también.'''
| Are we going to go to a French restaurant? | '''¿Vamos a ir a un restaurante francés?'''
| I want to eat Lojban food. | '''Yo quiero comer comida española.'''
| Good. Let's go to a Lojban restaurant. | '''Bueno. Vamos a un restaurante español.'''
| Let's go! | '''¡Vamos!'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the [[#More Vocabulary|More Vocabulary]] section.
{{SbcQuestion
| We are hungry. | '''Tenemos hambre.'''
| We too. Are you going to eat? (informal, plural) | '''Nosotros también. ¿Vais a comer?'''
| Yes, we want to go to an Italian restaurant. | '''Sí, queremos ir a un restaurante italiano.'''
| Good idea. | '''Buena idea.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the More Vocabulary section.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| We are hungry. | '''Tenemos hambre.'''

}}</includeonly>
